name: 두 개의 스팟 · S
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The attached image is the exact EDIT TARGET: Spotlog concept 03, two hollow circular spot endpoints connected by a red path, on warm off-white. Create ONE additional variant of this SAME icon by changing the connecting path into a clearly recognizable UPRIGHT CAPITAL S silhouette.

KEEP: the exact warm off-white full-bleed square background, the same vivid red connecting line and red hollow endpoint ring, the same blue hollow endpoint ring, the simple flat clean style, the similar ring sizes and stroke weight, the generous app-icon margins. Exactly TWO hollow ring endpoints, one blue at the UPPER RIGHT and one red at the LOWER LEFT.

CHANGE ONLY THE ROUTE SHAPE: from the blue upper-right ring, the RED route travels LEFT across a broad upper curve, turns smoothly DOWN at the upper-left, flows RIGHT through the center, curves down around a broad lower-right turn, then travels LEFT to join the red lower-left ring. This should trace the familiar normal Latin letter S, with two broad opposing curves, NOT the current diagonal elbow, NOT a backwards S, NOT a vertical sinusoid, NOT a squiggle, NOT an infinity sign. The rings terminate the S at its upper-right and lower-left ends. The connecting stroke should join the LEFT side of the blue upper-right ring and the RIGHT side of the red lower-left ring, following the horizontal tangents of an S.

The result should read naturally both as two places connected by a route and as the letter S for Spotlog. No standalone letter added. No change of palette, no gradient, no shadow, no new symbols or text, no watermark. Preserve the source identity closely. Single centered flat app-icon artwork, fully opaque square background, no outer app tile or comparison sheet.
